command_line:
set -eu
# Write extraction script to avoid quoting issues
cat > extract.py << 'PYEOF'
import zipfile, os, sys
os.makedirs("lineage_data", exist_ok=True)
with zipfile.ZipFile(sys.argv[1]) as z:
    for f in z.namelist():
        if f.startswith("lineages/eukaryota_odb10/"):
            z.extract(f, "lineage_data")
